maddeler.e:
ننأطر (form VII)
# نَنْأَطِرُ (nanʔaṭiru) /nan.ʔa.tˤi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْأَطَرَ (inʔaṭara)
# نَنْأَطِرَ (nanʔaṭira) /nan.ʔa.tˤi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْأَطَرَ (inʔaṭara)
# نَنْأَطِرْ (nanʔaṭir) /nan.ʔa.tˤir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْأَطَرَ (inʔaṭara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
